title: Spanish Tortilla with Banana
description: A sweet twist on the classic Spanish tortilla, featuring caramelized bananas.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the sliced bananas and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the tortilla and 1 egg.
Pour the tortilla mixture over the onions and bananas in the skillet.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the bottom is set.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 8-10 minutes.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
